links.comparator_used: Off-the-shelf large language model without retrieval augmentation (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Quality of generated clinical trial protocol sections across four dimensions (clinical thinking and logic; transparency and references; medical terminology; content relevance)
links.effect: Off-the-shelf LLM scored ≈40% or less on clinical thinking and logic and on transparency and references; with RAG these scores increased to ≈80%. Off-the-shelf LLM scored over 80% on content relevance and terminology.
links.quote: The use of retrieval-augmented generation substantially improves the writing quality of the large language model, with clinical thinking and logic and transparency and references scores increasing to ≈80%.

design_hint: retrieval-augmented generation grounding added to an off-the-shelf LLM
